feedback: The prior applicability repair remains incomplete. Add an explicit required hasDesignCondition relationship on the ship (at least one, and constrain uniqueness if the verified model requires one), so an applicable ship cannot pass when the linked design condition is absent. Keep the applicable branch restricted to all three selectors being present and inside their corresponding sets, and add the required non-applicable branch with at least one selector outside its set; missing selector or branch-selection evidence must not pass. The linked designCondition must then require all applicable normal-service-life, FP-reversal where pitchType is fixed, stopped-propeller-dragging, and radial-entry evidence, with each boolean explicitly true.

Remove the top-level sh:in restriction on nltl:iceClass and place that restriction only in the controllable and fixed applicable branches; as written, a ship with an out-of-scope ice class cannot satisfy the non-applicable alternative, so the alternatives are contradictory. Also move the top-level nltl:hasDesignCondition minCount requirement into the applicable branches (or otherwise make it conditional), because the non-applicable branch must not require an applicable design-condition relationship. Retain the required linked design-condition evidence for applicable controllable and fixed cases, with fixedPitchPropellerReversalLoadIncluded=true only in the fixed-pitch branch.

The candidate is semantically faithful and passes deterministic validation. It correctly separates controllable, fixed, and non-applicable alternatives; requires all selectors for applicability; uses an outside-set condition for non-applicability; keeps ship-owned properties on the ship; links applicable cases to designCondition; and conditionally requires fixed-pitch reversal evidence only in the fixed-pitch branch.
